brief: Review the fictional service’s proposed headline: “Every trade-in is a zero-waste upgrade.”
result: Replace the absolute claim with “Explore repair and trade-in options for your device.” Ask a human reviewer to check any environmental claim against documented collection, reuse and recycling practices before publication.
rationale: An absolute zero-waste claim needs evidence this demonstration does not have. FTC guidance supports specific, qualified wording.
considerations: This is a communication example, not legal clearance or proof of environmental performance.

sources.title: FTC: Environmental Claims — Summary of the Green Guides
sources.statement: The FTC advises against broad, unqualified environmental-benefit claims and calls for clear, specific qualifications.
